components.name: Floating section navigation
components.description: Large, bold, straight links stay centered as a group. Thin rules separate the labels, and an animated royal blue rule marks the active section.
components.html: HomeAboutProjectsStackCertificatesContact
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 10rem; font: 780 1.2rem var(--font-body, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 50px; color: var(--fg, #0a0a09); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:not(:last-child) { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #d8cfc1); } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 1px; background: var(--focus, #0504aa); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 300ms ease; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--focus, #0504aa); } .ds-nav a[aria-current]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0504aa); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav a::after { transition: none; } }

narrative.northStar: A typographic portrait opens a working portfolio.
narrative.overview:
The supplied reference sets the visual character. A condensed role headline spans warm paper. Froilan’s photograph crosses its lower edge like a printed portrait, with the name and actions set in a bold neutral sans. The supplied royal blue #0504aa identifies Know Me Better, the hero button that links to About.

The scrolling portfolio carries the paper and ink treatment from the portrait hero through About, Projects, Stack, Certificates, and Contact. Project and document images retain their original colors. The shared source is src/portfolio.css.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed display type and bold sans-serif labels
A fixed light palette with warm paper, near-black controls, and royal-blue primary actions
A tilted portrait print and aligned sections on one page
dos: Do keep concurrent choices and their labels readable at narrow widths.
Do preserve the supplied colors and content of project previews.
Do keep focus visible and make motion optional for reduced-motion visitors.
Do keep the featured project screenshot flat and use overlap on the prints behind it.
donts: Don’t put navigation over the work or cover form controls with fixed chrome.
